purpose: Production-fit still. Sole input to Curtis's reusable Kling motion base. Not an approval record.

derived_from.status: APPROVED appearance reference - below the 1920x1080 floor. Byte-identical, never modified.

why_this_exists: Spec F-1 / C-12a: the approved reference is 1672x941, below the A 1.4.1 / B 6 1080p floor, and is recorded as a pilot-render blocker. This file closes that gap for Curtis by upscaling to a NEW file. It does not supersede the approval record.

step_1_upscale.why_this_model: Precision/photo upscaler, non-generative. The documented route (docs/PRODUCTION_READINESS_COST_LOCK.md 1.4). A generative model would reinterpret identity, wardrobe, lighting and environment - the things Roger approved.

input.image_url: <fal CDN temporary input, 24 h expiry, neutral filename>

step_2_conform.rows_removed: 1 row from the BOTTOM of the 2x image = 0.5 row of the approved image (0.053% of height), from the dark desk surface at the frame edge
step_2_conform.why_2x_then_down: 3344x1881 is EXACTLY 16:9, so the crop is a single row and the downscale to 1920x1080 is a UNIFORM 0.574163x on both axes - zero aspect distortion. Going 1672->1920 directly lands at 1920x1081 and forces either an anisotropic scale or a full-resolution row crop. Downscaling from 2x also retains more real detail than a 1.148x enlargement.
step_2_conform.bit_depth: 16-bit RGB intermediate (rgb48le); 8-bit output only at write

measured_at_approval_resolution.method: new still resampled back to 1672x941 (lanczos) and differenced against the approved reference
measured_at_approval_resolution.control_plain_lanczos_round_trip: 0.330/255 (what a pure resample costs; the difference is the detail Topaz reconstructed)

verification.registration: best 2D fit over +/-6 px on the wall-screen block is dx=0, dy=0 - no shift, no crop, no reframing

detail_gain_at_1920x1080.method: laplacian variance vs a plain lanczos enlargement of the approved reference
detail_gain_at_1920x1080.relevance: Curtis carries the project's only mouth-specific softness watch item (-11.8 pp, beard). Real reconstructed detail in that region is exactly what that watch item needs.

verification.visual_inspection: Face, beard, wardrobe, expression, environment and framing unchanged at 1:1. All in-scene lettering verified letter-for-letter against the reference: wall screen 'EXIMIOUS ACADEMY', mug 'EXIMIOUS ACADEMY', book spines 'LEADERSHIP EXCELLENCE' / 'CLAIMS LEADERSHIP' (the third spine's pre-existing garbled lettering is reproduced garbled in the same way - proof the text was sharpened, not regenerated).
